title: Zoning text change for Fort Hamilton Mews, Bay Ridge
summary: This resolution approves a Zoning Resolution text amendment designating a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area for a site at 9305 Fifth Avenue in Bay Ridge, Brooklyn. It would work with a related zoning map change to allow an 11-story building with 292 apartments, about 88 of them permanently income-restricted, plus commercial and community facility space. The Council approved the measure on October 8, 2026.
